It is seated in New Delhi, the capital of India.The government comprises three branches: the executive, the legislative and the judiciary. The executive branch headed by the President, who is the Head of State and exercises his or her power directly or through officers subordinate to him.[1] The Legislative branch or the Parliament consists of the lower house, the Lok Sabha, and the upper house, the Rajya Sabha, as well as the president. The Judicial branch has the Supreme Court at its apex, 21 High Courts, and numerous civil, criminal and family courts at the district level.The basic civil and criminal laws governing the citizens of India are set down in major parliamentary legislation, such as the Civil Procedure Code, the Indian Penal Code, and the Criminal Procedure Code. The union and individual state governments consist of executive, legislative and judicial branches. The legal system as applicable to the federal and individual state governments is based on the English Common and Statutory Law. India accepts International Court of Justice jurisdiction with several reservations.

basic_info.description: For over three decades, Allcargo Global (formerly Allcargo Logistics) has been shaping how the world moves. What began with a single vision to simplify global trade has grown into a worldwide logistics powerhouse.As part of the Allcargo Group, and through our wholly owned subsidiary, ECU Worldwide, we connect businesses across 60 countries, offering reliable, neutral, and scalable logistics solutions.Our portfolio — anchored by our leadership as the world’s No. 1 LCL consolidator — includes Neutral FCL, Air Freight, multimodal transport, door-to-door delivery, and value-added services, enabling end-to-end solutions that keep global supply chains moving seamlessly.Powered by ECU360, our digital platform, we combine innovation with experience — making logistics faster, smarter, and easier to manage.Built on purpose, sustainability, and trust, Allcargo Global continues to move not just cargo, but the ambitions and growth of businesses worldwide.As one of Allcargo Group’s flagship companies, we create synergies to offer CFS-ICD under Allcargo Terminals Limited, as well as a nationwide footprint of strategically located logistics and industrial parks.Give your business the advantage of more than three decades of expertise, and count on our digital-first and customer-centric approach to bolster business growth and progress.Partner with us to experience a world of difference, backed by ingenuity, innovation, and strong commitment to Environmental, Social and Governance standards with an aim to be carbon neutral by 2040.
